# BAD-070 — Spike BAD-036 §8 step 5: the render-diff normalisation misses countdown()

## Brief
PR 2 of BAD-054 runs the same render diff and will hit a false failure. The spike's perl only normalises relative()'s outputs (just now, Nm/Nh/Nd ago). countdown() in @/lib/format.ts emits a different shape, 'in Nh Nm' or 'in Nm', and Allowance renders it as ' · next {countdown(verdict.nextAt)}'. Two of the nine seed accounts (cass and dev) are deliberately on cooldown, so those two pages carry a live countdown that moves by minutes between the before and after captures.

Evidence: Confirmed in my PR 1 run: render.after/cass.tab_user.html and render.after/dev.tab_user.html each contain one 'next AGE' and one 'on cooldown'. I added `s#\\bin \\d+h \\d+m\\b#AGE#g; s#\\bin \\d+m\\b#AGE#g` to the spike's perl. A control capture from the SAME before build, taken minutes later, then diffed byte-identical against the first (diff -r render.before render.before2, empty) — which is the evidence the extension is sufficient and the only clock-dependent text left. Without it those two accounts would have diffed on every run. Spike: /Users/ericlugo/Personal/Spud/docs/spikes/bad-036/admin-account-page.md §8 step 5.
